permission.licenseNotice: No original-author or public redistribution license was supplied. These files must not be labelled CC0 or assumed publicly redistributable. No purchase or public deployment was performed.

materialPolicy.rendering: Project soft-toon integration uses basecolor and normal detail; specular response is intentionally omitted.
materialPolicy.roughnessAndMetallic: The source embeds roughness and metallic textures. Three.js FBXLoader 0.186.1 does not automatically apply the exported ShininessExponent and ReflectionFactor texture links. Their presence is preserved in the original FBX but this integration does not claim full PBR support.
